A.name: US Sector Breadth
A.desc: US sector top-K breadth rotation (K=7); rotates into the strongest S&P 500 sectors by share of constituents above their 200-day moving average.

B.name: Cross-Asset Trend
B.desc: Cross-asset trend rotation; holds the broad-market, regional and commodity sleeves that are above their 200-day moving average.

C.name: Thematic Momentum
C.desc: Thematic momentum rotation across cyber, clean energy, solar, battery and China-semiconductor baskets.

D.name: Europe Sector Breadth
D.desc: Europe (Stoxx 600) sector breadth rotation, mirroring sleeve A on the European sector universe.

TILT.name: EM Tilt
TILT.desc: EEM/SPY golden-cross tilt of 10% NAV, funded from sleeve B. Weak-evidence positional bet, not robust alpha.

attribution.method: Historical published model holdings, effective after their fill-date close; daily contributions linked using prior official NAV / starting NAV. ETF contributions are gross of model trading costs; strategies use published net sleeve returns through the engine anchor and fixed-book marks thereafter. Unexplained residuals are shown separately.

return_context.method: 252 prior matched single-session returns, known at the period-start close; sample standard deviation scaled by the square root of the actual session count. Model return / model volatility; excess return / active-return volatility. Zero-centred volatility units, without subtracting an expected return; not a z-score, probability band or risk limit. Historical model risk, not a current-holdings forecast. Monthly scaling approximates compounding and assumes stable variance and no serial correlation.

etf_return_context.method: Full-window USD adjusted ETF/proxy return divided by its own estimated horizon volatility. 252 prior valid NYSE valuation-interval returns, ending no later than the period-start close; sample standard deviation scaled by the square root of the actual NYSE interval count. FX uses same-date rates; local closes are asynchronous and carried only across verified exchange holidays. Missing open-session marks are not filled. The ratio includes income and carry and is not a z-score, probability or statistical surprise. Monthly scaling assumes stable variance and no serial correlation. ETF return covers the full window, including days not held; portfolio contribution uses historical holdings.

risk.note: Annualised from the most recent ~1y of daily returns. Risk contribution = w*(Sigma w)/sigma_p, summing to 100%. European holdings are priced in local currency.
